newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish farmers say cost of flood damage 14 mln punt.
newsitem.headline: Irish farmers say cost of flood damage 14 mln punt.

text.p: The Irish Farmers' Association (IFA) said on Wednesday that it estimated flood damage was in excess of 14 million Irish pounds as torrential rain continued to wreak havoc in many counties in Ireland.
IFA President John Donnelly said the destruction of grain crops and flooding grassland could cost farmers up to 14 million Irish pounds in damage, Irish media reported on Wednesday.
The Irish army has been called in to help some people evacuate their homes and sand-bag flooded areas.
Up to 30 people abandoned their homes in the midland town of Clonmel last night as the River Suir broke its banks, flooding many houses in the town.
